description: This file is a Node.js script that provides a command-line utility for terminating processes listening on a specified TCP port. It attempts to identify processes using either 'lsof' or 'ss', then sends termination signals to them, with options to force kill non-Node processes.

methods.name: getPids(port)
methods.description: Retrieves process IDs listening on a given port by executing system commands and parsing their outputs.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, identifies processes on the specified port, and attempts to terminate them.
